description: Audit records from different sources are not correlated to identify patterns indicating potential security incidents. This signal indicates that coordinated attacks or complex incidents may go undetected.
applicability: Applicable to organizations with multiple log sources. Includes SIEM correlation rules, cross-system event analysis, and automated threat detection based on log patterns.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through SIEM correlation rule review, automated alerting assessment, and cross-system analysis capability verification.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - Audit and Accountability
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
